outcomes.name: Understanding of the process changes has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The process changes is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Process & Sustainment is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the process changes.
Identify why the process changes hasn't landed consistently for Process & Sustainment in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the process changes for Process & Sustainment.
Confirm the process changes for Process & Sustainment is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Process & Sustainment regularly to ensure the process changes stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Skills & Behaviour has been affected by inconsistent process changes since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Skills & Behaviour-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Skills & Behaviour in teams/sites where the process changes is weakest.
Confirm Skills & Behaviour has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Skills & Behaviour so gaps in the process changes are caught early in future.
